jaime: quick flag  after the kernel-picker tweak some proxy hosts show higher user CPU, p99 up. flame top points to tokenize/serialize + grpc small-write churn. attaching quick snippets. anyone around to triage? :eyes:
devin: where is this happening? flame sample and syscall counters pls. my initial thought is writev churn + kvcache pressure from batching changes.
jaime: eu-west3 proxy pool. flame (approx):
```
  47% host::tokenize_serialize
  29% net::grpc::emit_writev
  14% parse::frame_reassembly
  10% kernel::generic_fallback
```
writev ~9 calls per 1KB output.
ravi: same timeframe shows kvcache eviction spikes and lowered hit-rate, especially on hot shards. batching window oscillation can expose more parse work and reduce cache warmups.
devin: did you run a quick canary with kernel_prefetch toggled or adjust batch.window_ms? we should test microbatcher too.
jaime: ran a single-node canary with kernel_prefetch=on + batch.window_ms=3: small req CPU -8%, long-seq p99 +3.5%. kvcache hit dropped 0.85->0.68 at peak, evictions/sec 280->1100. writev counts small->3, long->27.
ravi: classic tradeoff. prefetch reduces syscall count for short flows but harms long-tail because of earlier serialization and slower cache warming. propose a 3x2 matrix: prefetch on/off x window_ms (3/15) plus a follow-up microbatch config. measure p50/p95/p99 CPU, tokenize wall_ns, writev/syscalls/request, per-shard kvcache histos.
devin: agree. also check transport coalescing flags: `transport.write_coalesce=true` may not trigger if runtime calls flush frequently. audit flush sites in streamer/tokenizer.
jaime: infra-bot: spawn canaries for matrix A/B/C now. /perf run --matrix=on_off_x_window --trace=flame,kvcache,syscalls
perf-bot: runs queued (start 4759994300).
perf-bot: quick results for window_ms=15 + prefetch=on: small req CPU -6%, mixed-workload p99 -4.2% overall, kvcache hit improved to 0.79, evictions/sec halved vs spike, writev/syscall per-request dropped ~55% for short flows, long-flow p99 within +1% noise.
ravi: microbatcher seems promising for mixed traffic; it coalesces writes but adds bounded latency. try microbatch(count=4,max_delay_ms=6) in variant D.
devin: add kernel-variant serialize microbench to validate we didn't regress serialize_ns for selected kernels; gate kernel-picker on that microbench in CI.
jaime: filing PERF-4307 with hypothesis, flames, and recommended interim flags: `kernel_prefetch=on`, `batch.window_ms=15`, `microbatch(count=4,max_delay_ms=6)`, keep `transport.write_coalesce=true`. include rollback plan. link: https://perf.internal/runs/47599943
ravi: action items:
- devin: run full matrix + microbatch D and upload CSVs with per-shard histos.
- ravi: add microbench and CI gate for kernel-picker.
- jaime: file perf ticket and coordinate limited rollout.
devin: will kick off runs and post CSV in this thread. thanks folks. :thumbsup:
